git tag -d daily-bench-tag 2>/dev/null || true

set -eu
'grit-bench' prepare-daily-reset --git git
cd /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/worktree-run-synth-10k && git worktree remove --force /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/daily-linked-wt 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/daily-linked-wt

set -eu
'grit-bench' prepare-daily-reset --git git
cd /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/worktree-run-synth-10k && (git worktree remove --force /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/daily-linked-wt 2>/dev/null || true) && rm -rf /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/daily-linked-wt && git worktree add /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/daily-linked-wt HEAD

notes: Measured on main d8dab25ebf210f30e619dbf725ccdc1ae190338b (v0.5.32) with `grit-bench daily` (one invocation per scenario via --only so one failing scenario cannot abort the run; 3 warmups, timed ABAB runs per tool, default per-scenario budget) on a 4-vCPU VM; grit is compared with git 2.43.0 only. The run started 2026-11-08T23:10Z and ended after midnight UTC; the report keeps the start date. samples_ms are the raw timed runs including cold first runs, so stddev_ms can be inflated by them; median_ms is robust to that. The `repos` table is carried over from the previous report (same pinned fixtures, git.git v2.47.0). All 172 scenarios completed for both tools; no failures (log/stat-n50@git-git, which failed in the previous report, passed this time). grit-http-server was built and put on PATH for the HTTP scenarios. Noise check against the 2026-11-05 report: re-run 3 more times, samples pooled (median of all runs): clone/shallow-depth1-http@synth-10k (time ratio 0.89->1.14), merge/content-both-sides@wide-20k (RSS ratio 1.18->1.56), stash/list@synth-10k (RSS ratio 0.84->1.16). No other scenario was re-run. After pooling, the clone/shallow-depth1-http and stash/list regressions disappeared (time ratio 1.01 and 0.82, RSS ratio 0.97 and 0.94); merge/content-both-sides@wide-20k stays at an RSS ratio of 1.37 (grit 77.5 MB vs git 56.7 MB) with time ratio 0.92. max_rss_kb is peak RSS of the timed command converted from bytes. grit-bench also flags five extra rows as headline (branch/list-json, branch/merged, log/json-100, pull/rebase, push/force-with-lease); this report marks only the 17 scenarios from the headline table.
